verses.greek: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Γαλιλαίας τῆς Τιβεριάδος.
verses.literal: After these things went away the Jesus over the Sea the of Galilee — the of Tiberias.
verses.dgt: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, that is, the Sea of Tiberias.

verses.greek: ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, ὅτι ἐθεώρουν τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσθενούντων.
verses.literal: Was following now after Him a crowd great because they were experiencing the signs which He was doing upon those being sick.
verses.dgt: A large crowd was following him because they were seeing the signs he was doing on the sick.

verses.greek: ἀνῆλθεν δὲ εἰς τὸ ὄρος Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Went up now on the mountain Jesus and there He was sitting with the disciples of Him.
verses.dgt: Jesus went up on the mountain and sat there with his disciples.

verses.greek: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα, ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.literal: Was now near the Passover the feast of the Jews.
verses.dgt: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.

verses.greek: ἐπάρας οὖν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος ὅτι πολὺς ὄχλος ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγει πρὸς Φίλιππον· Πόθεν ἀγοράσωμεν ἄρτους ἵνα φάγωσιν οὗτοι;
verses.literal: Having lifted up then the eyes the Jesus and having seen that a great crowd is coming to Him He says to Philip From where we may buy bread that may eat these?
verses.dgt: Then Jesus lifted up his eyes and saw that a large crowd was coming to him. He said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread so that these people may eat?”

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν πειράζων αὐτόν, αὐτὸς γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἔμελλεν ποιεῖν.
verses.literal: This now He was saying testing him He himself for knew what He was about to do.
verses.dgt: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he was about to do.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Φίλιππος· Διακοσίων δηναρίων ἄρτοι οὐκ ἀρκοῦσιν αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἕκαστος βραχύ τι λάβῃ.
verses.literal: Answered Him Philip Two hundred denarii worth of loaves not are sufficient for them that each little piece one may receive.
verses.dgt: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread would not be enough for each of them to receive even a little.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου·
verses.literal: Says to Him one of the disciples of Him Andrew the brother of Simon Peter
verses.dgt: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

verses.greek: Ἔστιν παιδάριον ὧδε ὃς ἔχει πέντε ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ δύο ὀψάρια· ἀλλὰ ταῦτα τί ἐστιν εἰς τοσούτους;
verses.literal: Is a little boy here who has five loaves barley and two small fish but these what are for so many?
verses.dgt: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are these for so many people?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ποιήσατε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀναπεσεῖν. ἦν δὲ χόρτος πολὺς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ. ἀνέπεσαν οὖν οἱ ἄνδρες τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὡς πεντακισχίλιοι.
verses.literal: Said the Jesus do make the men to recline. There was now grass much in the place. Reclined therefore the men the number about five thousand.
verses.dgt: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” There was much grass in the place, so the men sat down, about five thousand in number.

verses.greek: ἔλαβεν οὖν τοὺς ἄρτους ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εὐχαριστήσας διέδωκεν τοῖς ἀνακειμένοις, ὁμοίως καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὅσον ἤθελον.
verses.literal: Took then the loaves the Jesus and having given thanks He distributed to the reclining likewise also of the fish as much as they were wishing.
verses.dgt: Then Jesus took the loaves, and after giving thanks he distributed them to those who were reclining. He did the same with the fish, as much as they wanted.

verses.greek: ὡς δὲ ἐνεπλήσθησαν λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Συναγάγετε τὰ περισσεύσαντα κλάσματα, ἵνα μή τι ἀπόληται.
verses.literal: When now they were filled He says to the disciples of Him do gather together the having been over and above fragments so that nothing anything may be lost.
verses.dgt: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather the pieces that remain, so that nothing is lost.”

verses.greek: συνήγαγον οὖν, καὶ ἐγέμισαν δώδεκα κοφίνους κλασμάτων ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἄρτων τῶν κριθίνων ἃ ἐπερίσσευσαν τοῖς βεβρωκόσιν.
verses.literal: They gathered together therefore and filled twelve hand-baskets of fragments from the five loaves the barley which exceeded to those having eaten.
verses.dgt: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with pieces from the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

verses.greek: οἱ οὖν ἄνθρωποι ἰδόντες ὃ ἐποίησεν σημεῖον ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: The therefore people having seen what He had done sign were saying that This is truly the prophet who is coming into the world.
verses.dgt: When the people saw the sign he had done, they were saying, “This truly is the Prophet who is coming into the world.”

verses.greek: Ἰησοῦς οὖν γνοὺς ὅτι μέλλουσιν ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἁρπάζειν αὐτὸν ἵνα ποιήσωσιν βασιλέα ἀνεχώρησεν πάλιν εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτὸς μόνος.
verses.literal: Jesus therefore having known that they are about to come and to seize Him that they may make king withdrew again to the mountain Himself alone.
verses.dgt: Then Jesus, knowing that they were about to come and seize him in order to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself alone.

verses.greek: Ὡς δὲ ὀψία ἐγένετο κατέβησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,
verses.literal: When now evening it became went down the disciples of Him to the sea
verses.dgt: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

verses.greek: καὶ ἐμβάντες εἰς πλοῖον ἤρχοντο πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ σκοτία ἤδη ἐγεγόνει καὶ οὔπω ἐληλύθει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,
verses.literal: and having climbed into a boat they were going over the sea to Capernaum. And dark already it had become and not yet had come to them the Jesus
verses.dgt: and after getting into a boat they began crossing the sea toward Capernaum. Darkness had already come, and Jesus had not yet come to them.

verses.greek: ἥ τε θάλασσα ἀνέμου μεγάλου πνέοντος διεγείρετο.
verses.literal: the And the sea by a wind strong blowing was agitated.
verses.dgt: The sea was becoming rough because a strong wind was blowing.

verses.greek: ἐληλακότες οὖν ὡς σταδίους εἴκοσι πέντε ἢ τριάκοντα θεωροῦσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐγγὺς τοῦ πλοίου γινόμενον, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.
verses.literal: Having rowed therefore about stadia twenty five or thirty they see the Jesus walking on the sea and near the boat coming and they were frightened.
verses.dgt: After rowing about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat, and they became afraid.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.
verses.literal: the And He says to them I myself am He not do fear.
verses.dgt: But he said to them, “It is I. Do not be afraid.”

verses.greek: ἤθελον οὖν λαβεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο τὸ πλοῖον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑπῆγον.
verses.literal: They were willing then to receive Him into the boat and immediately was the boat at the land to which they were going.
verses.dgt: Then they were willing to receive him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.

verses.greek: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ἑστηκὼς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶδον ὅτι πλοιάριον ἄλλο οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἰ μὴ ἕν, καὶ ὅτι οὐ συνεισῆλθεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἀλλὰ μόνοι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον·
verses.literal: On the next day the crowd which already standing on the other side of the sea having seen that boat other no was there only except one and for not went with the disciples of Him the Jesus into the boat but alone the disciples of Him went away
verses.dgt: The next day the crowd standing on the other side of the sea saw that there had been only one boat there and that Jesus had not entered the boat with his disciples, but that his disciples had gone away alone.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ἦλθεν πλοιάρια ἐκ Τιβεριάδος ἐγγὺς τοῦ τόπου ὅπου ἔφαγον τὸν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσαντος τοῦ κυρίου.
verses.literal: another came boats from Tiberias near the place where they ate the bread when was giving thanks to the Lord.
verses.dgt: Other boats came from Tiberias near the place where they had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

verses.greek: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ οὐδὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, ἐνέβησαν αὐτοὶ εἰς τὰ πλοιάρια καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ζητοῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.literal: When therefore saw the crowd that Jesus not is there nor are the disciples of Him they climbed themselves into the boats and came to Capernaum seeking the Jesus
verses.dgt: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

verses.greek: Καὶ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπον αὐτῷ· Ῥαββί, πότε ὧδε γέγονας;
verses.literal: And having found Him on the other side of the sea they said to Him Rabbi when here have You come?
verses.dgt: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητεῖτέ με οὐχ ὅτι εἴδετε σημεῖα ἀλλʼ ὅτι ἐφάγετε ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων καὶ ἐχορτάσθητε·
verses.literal: Answered them the Jesus and said Amen Amen I say to you you seek Me not because you saw signs but because you ate of the loaves and were satisfied.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: you are seeking me not because you saw signs, but because you ate from the loaves and were filled.

verses.greek: ἐργάζεσθε μὴ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν ἀπολλυμένην ἀλλὰ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν μένουσαν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἣν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑμῖν δώσει, τοῦτον γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐσφράγισεν ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: do work not for the food that is perishing but for the food which is enduring unto life eternal which the Son the of Man to you will give Him for the Father has sealed the God.
verses.dgt: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For God the Father has set his seal on him.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν· Τί ποιῶμεν ἵνα ἐργαζώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ;
verses.literal: They said therefore to Him What shall we do that we may be doing the works the of God?
verses.dgt: Then they said to him, “What must we do so that we may be doing the works of God?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἔργον τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα πιστεύητε εἰς ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος.
verses.literal: Answered the Jesus and said to them This is the work the of God that you may believe in Him whom has sent He.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God: that you believe in the one whom he sent.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ· Τί οὖν ποιεῖς σὺ σημεῖον, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμέν σοι; τί ἐργάζῃ;
verses.literal: They said therefore to Him What then do You yourself as a sign that we may see and may believe You? What work do You perform?
verses.dgt: So they said to him, “Then what sign do you do, so that we may see and believe you? What work do you perform?

verses.greek: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸ μάννα ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον· Ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν.
verses.literal: The fathers of us the manna ate in the wilderness even as it is written: Bread from the heaven He gave them to eat.’
verses.dgt: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, just as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὁ πατήρ μου δίδωσιν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν ἀληθινόν·
verses.literal: Said therefore to them the Jesus Amen Amen I say to you not Moses has given you the bread from the heaven but the Father of Mine gives you the bread from the heaven the true.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ ἄρτος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ καταβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ζωὴν διδοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ.
verses.literal: The for bread the of God is the One coming down out of the heaven and life giving to the world.
verses.dgt: For the bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν· Κύριε, πάντοτε δὸς ἡμῖν τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον.
verses.literal: They said therefore to Him Sir always do give to us the bread this.
verses.dgt: Then they said to him, “Sir, always give us this bread.”

verses.greek: Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς· ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ διψήσει πώποτε.
verses.literal: Said to them the Jesus I myself am the bread the of life the one coming to Me myself certainly not may hunger and the one believing in Me myself certainly not will thirst at any time.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. The one who comes to me will certainly not hunger, and the one who believes in me will never thirst.

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ ἑωράκατέ με καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε.
verses.literal: But I said to you that also you have seen Me and yet not believe.
verses.dgt: But I told you that you have seen me and yet do not believe.

verses.greek: πᾶν ὃ δίδωσίν μοι ὁ πατὴρ πρὸς ἐμὲ ἥξει, καὶ τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρός με οὐ μὴ ἐκβάλω ἔξω,
verses.literal: All that gives Me the Father to Me myself will come and the one coming to Me myself certainly not shall I cast out
verses.dgt: Everything the Father gives me will come to me, and the one who comes to me I will certainly not cast out,

verses.greek: ὅτι καταβέβηκα ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐχ ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με·
verses.literal: For I have come down from the heaven not that I may do the will the of Me but the will of the One who having sent Me.
verses.dgt: because I have come down from heaven not to do my own will, but the will of the one who sent me.

verses.greek: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκέν μοι μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.literal: This now is the will of the One who having sent Me that all that He has given Me none I may lose of it but may raise up it the last day.
verses.dgt: And this is the will of the one who sent me: that I lose nothing of all that he has given me, but raise it up on the last day.

verses.greek: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου ἵνα πᾶς ὁ θεωρῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐγὼ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.literal: This for is the will of the Father Mine that everyone who is beholding the Son and believing in Him he may have life eternal and will raise up him I myself the last day.
verses.dgt: For this is my Father’s will: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him may have eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.”

verses.greek: Ἐγόγγυζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἶπεν· Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ καταβὰς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,
verses.literal: Were grumbling therefore the Jews about Him because He said I myself am the bread the having come down from the heaven
verses.dgt: So the Jews were grumbling about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”

verses.greek: καὶ ἔλεγον· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ, οὗ ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα; πῶς νῦν λέγει ὅτι Ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβέβηκα;
verses.literal: And they were saying Surely this is Jesus the son of Joseph of whom we ourselves know the father and the mother? How then says He that From the heaven I have come down?
verses.dgt: They were saying, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does he now say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Μὴ γογγύζετε μετʼ ἀλλήλων.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to them Not do grumble with one another.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered and said to them, “Do not grumble with one another.

verses.greek: οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ὁ πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με ἑλκύσῃ αὐτόν, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.literal: No one is able to come to Me only unless the Father the one having sent Me shall draw him and I myself will raise up him in the last day.
verses.dgt: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up on the last day.

verses.greek: ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις· Καὶ ἔσονται πάντες διδακτοὶ θεοῦ· πᾶς ὁ ἀκούσας παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μαθὼν ἔρχεται πρὸς ἐμέ.
verses.literal: It is written in the prophets: And they will be all taught of God.’ Everyone who having heard from the Father and having learned he comes to Me myself
verses.dgt: It is written in the Prophets, ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard from the Father and learned comes to me.

verses.greek: οὐχ ὅτι τὸν πατέρα ἑώρακέν τις εἰ μὴ ὁ ὢν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, οὗτος ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα.
verses.literal: Not for the Father has seen anyone only except the One being from the God He has seen the Father.
verses.dgt: Not that anyone has seen the Father except the one who is from God; he has seen the Father.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you the one believing has life eternal.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: the one who believes has eternal life.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς·
verses.literal: I myself am the bread the of life.
verses.dgt: I am the bread of life.

verses.greek: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ μάννα καὶ ἀπέθανον·
verses.literal: The fathers of You ate in the wilderness the manna and died
verses.dgt: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and died.

verses.greek: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνων ἵνα τις ἐξ αὐτοῦ φάγῃ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ·
verses.literal: This is the bread the from the heaven coming down that anyone of it may eat and not may die.
verses.dgt: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat from it and not die.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ζῶν ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς· ἐάν τις φάγῃ ἐκ τούτου τοῦ ἄρτου ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ ὁ ἄρτος δὲ ὃν ἐγὼ δώσω ἡ σάρξ μού ἐστιν ὑπὲρ τῆς τοῦ κόσμου ζωῆς.
verses.literal: I myself am the bread which is living the from the heaven having come down if anyone shall have eaten of this the bread he will live to the age. and the bread also that I myself will give the flesh of Me is for the of the world life.
verses.dgt: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats from this bread, he will live forever. And the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

verses.greek: Ἐμάχοντο οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες· Πῶς δύναται οὗτος ἡμῖν δοῦναι τὴν σάρκα αὐτοῦ φαγεῖν;
verses.literal: Were arguing therefore with one another the Jews saying How is able this man us to give the flesh of Him to eat?
verses.dgt: Then the Jews began arguing with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ φάγητε τὴν σάρκα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πίητε αὐτοῦ τὸ αἷμα, οὐκ ἔχετε ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.literal: Said therefore to them the Jesus Amen Amen I say to you only unless you shall have eaten the flesh of the Son the of Man and shall have drunk of Him the blood not you have life in yourselves.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you do not have life in yourselves.

verses.greek: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.literal: The one eating of My the flesh and drinking of My the blood has life eternal and I myself will raise up him in the last day.
verses.dgt: The one who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.

verses.greek: ἡ γὰρ σάρξ μου ἀληθής ἐστι βρῶσις, καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ⸁ἀληθής ἐστι πόσις.
verses.literal: The for flesh of Me true is food and the blood of Me true is drink.
verses.dgt: For my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.

verses.greek: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μένει κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: The one eating of My the flesh and drinking of My the blood in Me myself abides and I myself in him.
verses.dgt: The one who eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.

verses.greek: καθὼς ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ ζῶν πατὴρ κἀγὼ ζῶ διὰ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ὁ τρώγων με κἀκεῖνος ζήσει διʼ ἐμέ.
verses.literal: Even as sent Me the living Father and I myself live because of the Father also the one feeding on Me he also will live because of Me myself.
verses.dgt: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

verses.greek: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, οὐ καθὼς ἔφαγον οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἀπέθανον· ὁ τρώγων τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.literal: This is the bread the from heaven having come down not even as ate the fathers and died The one eating this the bread will live to the age.
verses.dgt: This is the bread that came down from heaven, not like what the fathers ate and died. The one who eats this bread will live forever.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν συναγωγῇ διδάσκων ἐν Καφαρναούμ.
verses.literal: These things He said in the synagogue teaching in Capernaum.
verses.dgt: He said these things while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

verses.greek: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἀκούσαντες ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπαν· Σκληρός ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος· τίς δύναται αὐτοῦ ἀκούειν;
verses.literal: Many therefore having heard of the disciples of Him said Difficult is the word this who is able it to hear?
verses.dgt: Then many of his disciples, after hearing this, said, “This saying is difficult. Who can listen to it?”

verses.greek: εἰδὼς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι γογγύζουσιν περὶ τούτου οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τοῦτο ὑμᾶς σκανδαλίζει;
verses.literal: knowing however the Jesus in Himself that are grumbling about this the disciples of Him He said to them This you does offend?
verses.dgt: But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples were grumbling about this, said to them, “Does this offend you?

verses.greek: ἐὰν οὖν θεωρῆτε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναβαίνοντα ὅπου ἦν τὸ πρότερον;
verses.literal: What if then you shall see the Son the of Man ascending where He was the before?
verses.dgt: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

verses.greek: τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ ζῳοποιοῦν, ἡ σὰρξ οὐκ ὠφελεῖ οὐδέν· τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λελάληκα ὑμῖν πνεῦμά ἐστιν καὶ ζωή ἐστιν.
verses.literal: The Spirit is the one giving life the flesh not profits no thing The declarations that I myself have spoken to you spirit are and life they are.
verses.dgt: The Spirit is the one who gives life; the flesh is of no benefit. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and are life.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ εἰσὶν ἐξ ὑμῶν τινες οἳ οὐ πιστεύουσιν. ᾔδει γὰρ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ μὴ πιστεύοντες καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδώσων αὐτόν.
verses.literal: But they are of you some who not believe. Knew for from the beginning the Jesus who are those not believing and who it is who will betray Him.
verses.dgt: But there are some among you who do not believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who those were who did not believe and who it was who would betray him.

verses.greek: καὶ ἔλεγεν· Διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ πατρός.
verses.literal: And He was saying Because of this have I said to you that no one is able to come to Me only unless it shall granted to him from the Father
verses.dgt: And he was saying, “For this reason I have told you that no one can come to me unless it has been granted to him by the Father.”

verses.greek: Ἐκ τούτου πολλοὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ οὐκέτι μετʼ αὐτοῦ περιεπάτουν.
verses.literal: From that time many out of the disciples of Him went away to the back and no longer with Him were walking.
verses.dgt: From that time many of his disciples went back and no longer walked with him.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς δώδεκα· Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε ὑπάγειν;
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus to the Twelve Surely not also you yourselves are wishing to go away?
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to the Twelve, “You do not want to go away too, do you?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα; ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις,
verses.literal: Answered Him Simon Peter Lord to whom will we go? declarations of life eternal You have
verses.dgt: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom will we go? You have words of eternal life,

verses.greek: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: and we ourselves have believed and have known that You yourself are the Holy One the of God
verses.dgt: and we have believed and have come to know that you are the Holy One of God.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς τοὺς δώδεκα ἐξελεξάμην; καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἷς διάβολός ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Answered them the Jesus Not I myself you the Twelve did choose and of you one a devil is?
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Did I not choose you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγεν δὲ τὸν Ἰούδαν Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου· οὗτος γὰρ ἔμελλεν παραδιδόναι αὐτόν, εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα.
verses.literal: He was speaking now the of Judas son of Simon Iscariot he for was about to betray Him one of the Twelve.
verses.dgt: Now he was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for he, one of the Twelve, was going to betray him.
